title: The Arrow Storm
text: Arrows fall from an empty sky over the valley the road must cross, thick as hail, hissing as they come. They stand in the ground like a field of reeds, some fresh, some rotten with age. There are no archers anywhere you can see.

options.label: The one the arrows always find runs ahead to draw them.

outcomes.text: They draw every arrow, bristling like a hedgehog, and the rest cross clean.
Too many arrows, too fast. One finds the gap.

options.label: Walk under shields, slowly, step by step.

outcomes.text: It takes all day, arrows hammering overhead, and dents every shield.

options.label: The sharpest eye looks for the archers.

outcomes.text: A ghost archer company on the ridge, still at war, still shooting. They turn as one to face you.
No one there. The arrows stop when you stop looking for them, and nobody knows why that is worse.
